jobs.title: Персонажи — предложение состава
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. The attached image is ONLY a drawing style reference, provisionally selected by the user: angular expressive adult editorial caricature, restrained teal/burgundy/navy/ochre palette, warm ivory paper, confident ink and dry printed grain. DO NOT copy its three people. Draw SIX ORIGINAL new fictional supporting characters for a political career mobile game in a fictional US-like republic. A clear landscape character selection board in a THREE COLUMN by TWO ROW grid, each cell has a generously framed waist-up portrait on ivory with breathing room, thin subtle separators, no text except one small numeral in each upper-left corner. All six clearly different ages, faces and silhouettes. NUMERAL 1: Elliot Finch, recurring colleague age30, male, light olive skin, short untidy dark curls, broad rounded face, expressive brows, moss green rolled-sleeve shirt and dark charcoal cardigan, small freckle at cheek, friendly wry smile, holding coffee. Not handsome generic model. NUMERAL 2: Vera Holt, office supervisor age48, woman, sturdy square build, straight black chin-length bob, strong nose, rust blazer cream high-neck blouse, no glasses, blunt skeptical expression, clipboard. NUMERAL 3: Marcus Rowe, local party organizer age37, dark-skinned man with shaved head and short beard, wiry, ochre overshirt with navy shirt, animated open-hand gesture, enthusiastic tired eyes. NUMERAL 4: Selma Crowe, legal advisor age56, woman, silver cropped CURLY hair, narrow angular face, rectangular black glasses, plum pantsuit, cool measured expression, slim legal notebook. NUMERAL 5: Adrian Knox, internal party operator age42, slim man, ash blond neatly side-parted hair, long sharp cheekbones, dark navy double-breasted suit muted copper tie, closed controlled smile, hands clasped behind back. NUMERAL 6: Cameron Steele, external presidential rival age46, woman, medium brown skin, dark hair in high neat bun, burgundy suit and ivory shirt with simple original geometric pin, strong confident open pose, knowing charismatic expression. This is proposed casting, original distinct people. Same polished illustration style and consistent portrait size for all six. Mature witty satire, no photorealism, no clay, no 3D render. No names or extra letters, no watermark.

jobs.title: Рабочие места 1–3 — начало карьеры
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Attached image is a STYLE reference only: angular adult political caricature, mature muted teal/navy/burgundy/ochre, restrained printed painted surface feel. Do not copy its people. Create a LANDSCAPE presentation of THREE side-by-side PORTRAIT game environment concepts. Each panel is clearly a genuine stylized THREE DIMENSIONAL Godot-game-style office with real geometry and cast shadows, artist-painted matte materials, same coherent art direction. Camera is from the seated player's OWN desk looking outward, desk foreground about bottom quarter, environment dominates. No people in foreground, no interface, no text, no parchment overlay or character sprites. CRITICAL: these are different spaces and layouts, NOT one room recolored. Comparable camera eye height, distinctive layouts and scales, clear depth. High quality believable achievable game environment concepts, not photorealism or clay. No existing country flags. No repeated identical three-door wall. Each panel gets only one tiny numeral in upper corner. Panel 1 numeral '1': LOWEST RANK, crowded open-plan PARTY OFFICE, player occupies one cramped battered laminate desk in a tiny cubicle with cheap fabric dividers, rows of other cubicles extend into a LARGE DEEP OPEN HALL, distant fluorescent ceiling strips, overhead pipes, communal printer, communal coat rack, no personal room, not poverty ruins, drab beige/moss/grey workaday humor. Player sees coworkers' empty chairs, no people needed. Panel 2 numeral '2': a SMALL SHARED LOCAL PARTY ROOM with only two desks, player desk against wall, spare chair and second desk diagonally across, boxes of campaign leaflets, narrow high window, cheap filing cabinet, useful but cramped, different geometry from panel1. Panel 3 numeral '3': FIRST PRIVATE REGIONAL OFFICE, modest personal wooden desk with a side visitor chair, one big street-facing window at left, city district map on far wall, asymmetrical corner shelving, daylight, right-side off-center door. Comfortable but not luxurious. No duplicate desk shape or lighting across all three.

jobs.title: Партии — три пары эмблем
jobs.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished FLAT emblem exploration board for TWO competing fictional political parties in a mobile satire game. THREE ROWS each shows a DIFFERENT possible pair. Exactly SIX emblems total, two per row, equal visual weight. Warm offwhite background, dark desaturated teal for left emblems, muted brick red for right emblems. Modern mature civic identities, simple strong silhouettes readable at 32 pixels, political seriousness with original geometrical design. No existing political logos, no elephant, donkey, eagle, hammer/sickle or existing national flag. Do not include party names or any wording, only tiny 'A', 'B', 'C' row labels. Row A: left a simple geometric BRIDGE ARCH formed by two symmetric joined pillars, right a DISTINCTIVE RISING HORIZON symbol with three asymmetric rays and open semicircle. Row B: left a BROKEN CIRCULAR MOSAIC made of five bold joined segments around a central open pentagon, right an INTERWOVEN DOUBLE CHEVRON representing solidarity without looking like handshake stock icon. Row C: left an abstract STEPPED CIVIC COLUMN built from three aligned strong forms, right three clean diagonal rising strokes joined at base creating a forward direction. Crisp clean flat shapes, no gradients, NO mockup on merchandise, no 3D, no excessive ornament, no shields or rings added automatically. Each logo sits with generous blank space; exact two-column three-row layout.
